definitions.explanation: The act of sending out goods from a warehouse or production facility to be delivered.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}{出荷|しゅっか}しました。
{出荷|しゅっか}{準備|じゅんび}が{完了|かんりょう}した。
{出荷|しゅっか}{予定|よてい}は{来週|らいしゅう}です。
examples.english: The scheduled shipment is next week.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出荷|しゅっか}する (to ship)
- {出荷|しゅっか}{準備|じゅんび} (shipping preparation)
- {出荷|しゅっか}{予定|よてい}{日|び} (scheduled shipping date)
- {出荷|しゅっか}{台数|だいすう} (number of units shipped)

RELATED TERMS:
- {入荷|にゅうか} (arrival of goods)
- {納品|のうひん} (delivery)
- {配送|はいそう} (delivery, shipping)
